# vn-code
Agent-Human ADE ⌨️
Bundles Plugins, Skills and Interfaces
Cross-platform Node ADE with core DSH for professional Engineering and Design: every plugin is **Nod
e.js** (plain JavaScript bundles, zero npm dependencies), while **Rust** is only the small front-doo
r installer binary that composes the harness home and runs the launcher. The launchers run on **Wind
ows, macOS and Linux**.
## Run
| | Windows | macOS / Linux |

| **The app** | `scripts\run-desktop.bat` | `./scripts/run-desktop.sh` |
| **Browser tab only** | `s
cripts\run-web.bat` | `./scripts/run-web.sh` |

`run-web` starts the pinned harness and opens the URL it prints in Chrome, falling back to
your defa

ult browser. `run-desktop` builds `vncode` when there is none and runs it: it
installs the pack if t

he home in use lacks it, asks for the DeepSeek key if there is none,
and then runs that same `run-we
b` in the foreground.

`vncode` is a small Rust binary - about **0.5 MB per OS** - with **no window and no embedded
browser

**: the interface is the same web application, in the browser you already use. Its
verbs are `start`

(the default), `install`, `uninstall`, `status` and `key`; `-Help` lists
the flags, and `app/README
.md` is the whole app on one page.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`vncode` never runs node itself: it starts `scripts/run-web.*`, which does. Nothing it does
needs a
window, a port or a browser of its own.

The URL is opened only when it names a **loopback** address, and the launch token is never
written t
o a file - both rules are in SECURITY.md.
## Plugins

Every package's own README is the reference for what it does, why it is built that
way and what it t

ouches. The exact versions are in
`.dsh-version.json`.
| Package | What it adds |
| `dsh-vn-master` | the browser-free master, installed **last** - the slot pack-wide patches and row
restatements go in (it enables the Browser tab on the web profile, and removes the feedback surface

) |
| `dsh-rightbar` | the pack's own right bar: tab strip, docking panel and the `sidebarRight` reg

istry (a fork of the shipped bar) |
| `dsh-rightbar-files` | the Files tab type on top of that bar |
| `dsh-editor` | text and code tabs (vendored CodeMirror 6), with a Markdown preview and Save/Creat

e |
| `dsh-gittree` | **read-only** History tab: the workspace's commits as a graph rail (lanes, mer

ges, PR chips), and the files each one touched |
| `dsh-image` | an image viewer that fits, zooms, p

ans, and reads the source pixel under the pointer |
| `dsh-image-upscale` | the agent can make a sma
ll image **big without making it worse**: four `upscale_*` tools over **Real-ESRGAN** (`realesr-gene
ral-x4v3` by default) run through the Python and torch **this machine already has** — `upscale_info`
says whether CUDA is there and which models are on disk, `upscale_image` writes a NEW file (never t
he original) with the model, device, ms and bytes in the answer, `upscale_batch` takes a manifest an
d is a dry run by DEFAULT (existing outputs skipped, not replaced), and `upscale_fetch_weights` down
loads one 4.7 MB model only after `confirm` repeats its name. Zero npm dependencies, no engine bundl
ed, and a four-line `torchvision.transforms.functional_tensor` shim so a `realesrgan` that is broken

against torchvision 0.17+ still runs |
| `dsh-audio` | a waveform surface: WAV/AIFF/FLAC, one track

per channel, dBFS, selection and playback |
| `dsh-media` | media the agent can work with: `media_p
robe` / `media_run` / `media_frames` over a **pinned, SHA-256-verified** ffmpeg copy, plus the route

s the video tab streams through |
[该节后续省略]
## Third-party content the pack vendors

Some bundles carry somebody else's work inside them. Nothing is fetched at run
time — the profile in

stalls a bundle as a live link, so an engine the plugin needs
on both sides of the app has to be on

disk — and every vendored tree keeps its
upstream `LICENSE` beside its bytes.
| what | bundles | how it is kept honest |
| **Mermaid** 11.17.2 (`lib/vendor/mermaid.min.js`) | `dsh-diagrams` | `node packages/dsh-diagrams/v

endor/build.mjs --check` re-hashes the recorded sha256 |
| **Diagram Design** — 204 worked examples,
44 documented visual types, 62 reference documents, MIT, `cathrynlavery/diagram-design` | `dsh-diag
rams` | `node packages/dsh-diagrams/vendor/design/build.mjs --check` re-hashes the whole 277-file tr

ee OFFLINE against a pinned commit |
| **pdf.js** 6.3.289 (`lib/vendor/pdf.min.mjs` + worker, cmaps,
fonts, wasm) | `dsh-pdf` | `node packages/dsh-pdf/vendor/build.mjs --check`, per-file hashes plus a

digest per tree |
| **Impeccable** 4.6.0 (`@2f46b7a`, Apache-2.0) — the 24-command skill corpus and
41 references, the 61-rule registry, and the detector built from the same `crates/core` + `crates/f
oundation` to `detect_bg.wasm` (4,558,054 bytes) + its CommonJS glue | `dsh-frontend-craft` | `node
packages/dsh-frontend-craft/vendor/impeccable/build.mjs --check` re-hashes every vendored file offli
ne against a pinned commit; the engine is built HERE from that pin (`build-engine.mjs`, 54 s cold) w
ith its Apache `LICENSE` and `NOTICE.md` beside it, and `VERSION.json` records the four textual tran

sforms as well as every byte |
[该节后续省略]
## Security & license

- **AGPL-3.0-only** - see LICENSE. Copyright (C) 2026 **vecnode**.
The pack is copyleft: you may run

, study, change and share it, and a version
you **distribute or offer over a network** must carry it

s source under the same
license. That is deliberate - vn-code is not to become a closed product on
s

omebody else's bench. A commercial exception is available on request; see
CONTRIBUTING.md for the CL

A that keeps that possible, and
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md for the vendored trees that keep
their own li

censes (Apache-2.0, MIT, LGPL-2.1) and are **not** relicensed by this.
- SECURITY.md: the threat mod

el, the launch token, the code this pack
runs on purpose (`dsh-supercollider`'s interpreter and its

`eval` route among them),
what the pack deliberately does not do, and how `check-no-secrets.mjs` kee

ps a
credential out of a commit. Report a vulnerability privately, as described there.
- ARCHITECTUR

E.md is the deep dive; docs/ holds install,
distribute, compatibility and per-host notes.
